Will we need to buy new software or subscriptions?

No. Everything is built inside the spreadsheets you already own — typically Excel or Google Sheets — plus free built-in tools like Power Query. There are no licences to pay, no monthly subscriptions, and nothing to rent.
How do you handle confidentiality and GDPR?

My consultancy work is conducted under strict confidentiality. I work under a written data processing agreement, never disclose client data, and remove my access as soon as the project ends. The demonstrations on this website use anonymised dummy data — clearly labelled, and never taken from client projects.
What actually happens in the free 30-minute Weekly-Report Walkthrough?

You share one weekly report on screen (a redacted copy is fine). I walk you through the 2–3 changes I would make first and email a written summary within two working days. No files are transferred, nothing is recorded, and there is no obligation to continue.

Every stage is fixed-price and agreed in writing before work starts. The Reporting Review even includes a full refund guarantee: if any of the three agreed deliverables is missing by the agreed date, you get your money back. That review fee is also deducted from any follow-on build signed within 12 months.
You do. Every formula is unlocked, you receive written handover notes so your team can run and adapt the report yourselves, and I am available afterward only if you want me to be.
Which businesses are you a good fit for?

UK catering and hospitality operators — restaurants, bars, cafés, caterers and venues — where weekly reporting is still assembled by hand from till, rota, invoice and stock exports. Usually a free walkthrough is enough to tell whether automation is worth doing.
